title: But one with handles!!
text: But one with handles!!. Good for storage bad for moving. Super tough to move mattress with slick plastic and no handles

product_metadata.title: ComfortHome Mattress Bag for Moving and Storage, 4 Mil Extra Thick, Twin and Full Size, 2 Pack
features: 【Twin/Full 】Size: Fits Twin/Full Size Mattress ( smaller than 54 × 75 inch ) with height up to 14 inches (≤14 inches), not including Twin XL or Full XL mattress. Please see the attached size guide picture to select a suitable plastic bag.

【Extra Thick & Heavy Weight Version】: Each package includes 2 bag made of 4 Mil extra thick polyethylene ( new material ). The item weight is about 3.4 pounds ( you could refer to "Product information" in detail page for accurate item weight). If you need a sturdier one, you could consider 6 Mil thick bag (Heavy Duty Version).

【NO Zipper/Closure/Handle】: Please NOTE that there is NO Zipper or Closure or adhesive strip on the end, you need to buy some packing tape to seal the mattress bag. Place mattress or box spring inside, then overlap the extra plastic and seal tight with packing tape.
No vent-hole design. Perfect for long term storage.
Perfect for moving, storage, renovation or mattress disposal. Great solution for disposing of mattress or box spring.
